requirements.scope: All twelve mechs and twelve drones; eight morphers and their forms remain excluded

criteria: Open ducts and separate mechanical joints
No unconnected parts in diagnostic views
Finite run, fire, cast and reversible shield poses

inputs.view: oblique action; rear and underside inferred

components.intent: Long faceted bee fuselage with compound sensor eyes and a tapered striped abdomen; no limbs
Exactly four open enclosed rotors, paired fore/aft on carbon arms
Nose underside coaxial gun and paired lateral rocket pods
Compact flush transducers mounted on the physical shield or melee implement, otherwise on the free elbow or both held weapons; wing and limb sweeps remain clear

decisions: The bee silhouette retains four enclosed rotors as propulsion; their supports articulate slowly with front/rear half-cycle phasing.
An opaque rotor disk would erase the reference's identity-critical duct openings
Shield geometry is presentation only; hit volumes and defense remain server-owned
